author: bardic-inspiration
name: Crypt Skulker
summary: A starved corpse-pack hunter that pounces from the dark of a tomb.
description: Skulkers hunt in threes where the dead are many and the living are few. They shadow a party through the burial halls until one of them lags behind.

traits.name: Pounce
traits.text: If the skulker moves at least 20 feet straight toward a creature and then hits it with a Gnaw attack on the same turn, it makes one extra Gnaw attack against that target as a bonus action.

traits.name: Pack Tactics
traits.text: The skulker has {ref:glossary/advantage} on attack rolls against a creature if at least one of the skulker's allies is within 5 feet of the creature and the ally doesn't have the {ref:condition/incapacitated} condition.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: The skulker makes two Gnaw attacks.

actions.name: Gnaw
actions.onHit: If the target is a Medium or smaller creature, it has the {ref:condition/prone} condition.
